title: bug: both mods' tracked tsconfig.json set no compilerOptions and take noEmit only from the gitignored, engine-written .claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json, so `tsc -p` in any task worktree or snapshot fails with TS5083 and writes register.js/register.test.js beside the sources, which then land (d27edf88's 5265909c: +1118 lines, QA reject 08:30Z 11-04)
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04 after the QA reject of task-d27edf88 (#governors ❌ msg-7a680d57, 08:30Z).

PROBLEM
- scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/tsconfig.json and scripts/mods/moe-compaction-keeper/tsconfig.json contain only `{ "extends": "./.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json" }`.
- That base is engine-written and gitignored (.gitignore:100 `scripts/mods/*/.claude-plugin/types/`). It is the only place `"noEmit": true` is set.
- In worktree mode every seat edits in .worktrees/<taskId>, and verifies in git-archive snapshots. The base is absent from all of them: the governor checked all 8 current worktrees and none has it.
- Governor repro at 3747c474, in a git-archive snapshot of scripts/mods with classic tsc 7.0.2 (moe-vscode/node_modules): `tsc -p scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/tsconfig.json` reports `TS5083: Cannot read file .../.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json` plus TS2307 and TS5097, and still writes hooks/register.js and hooks/register.test.js.
- That is how d27edf88's completion 5265909c landed both files (+300 and +818 lines, over the 400 net-LOC cap) and drew a QA reject. hooks.json loads ./register.ts, so the .js files are dead code. register.test.js also escapes the IDE bundles' `*.test.ts` exclusion (scripts/CLAUDE.md:41).

FIX
- Add `"compilerOptions": { "noEmit": true }` to both tracked tsconfig.json files and keep the extends.
- Governor check in the same snapshot: with that line, tsc writes nothing even when the base is missing. With the control checkout's base copied in, the account-switch type check reports exactly the planned baseline (TS5097 and TS2769 in register.test.ts) and still emits nothing.

SCOPE
- The two tsconfig.json files only.
- The deletion of the already-landed register.js and register.test.js belongs to task-d27edf88's rework (its step-4 was amended at 08:3xZ). Do not touch scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/hooks/.
- Out of scope: making the type check resolve its types inside a worktree, for example by having the launchers copy .claude-plugin/types into new worktrees. Mention it in the completion summary if you think it is worth a row.

VERIFY
- In a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout, run `tsc -p` for each mod, without the base and then with the base copied in from $MOE_PROJECT_PATH. Both runs must write no .js file.
- Then run `claude plugin test scripts/mods/moe-account-switch` and `claude plugin test scripts/mods/moe-compaction-keeper` under `env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"`.
definitionOfDone: Both scripts/mods/*/tsconfig.json files keep their extends and set compilerOptions.noEmit true. In a snapshot without .claude-plugin/types/, `tsc -p` on each mod writes no .js file, and the completion summary quotes the listing.

With the control checkout's base copied into the snapshot, each mod's type check reports the same errors as before the change (moe-account-switch: TS5097 and TS2769 only) and writes nothing. `claude plugin test` passes for both mods.
The diff changes only the two tsconfig.json files.

implementationPlan.note: Added compilerOptions.noEmit true to both tsconfig.json files; extends unchanged.

implementationPlan.description:
Run this exact command once, in bash from the worktree root. It needs MOE_PROJECT_PATH (the control checkout, /mnt/d/projexts/moes on this WSL host), which every seat has. It must exit 0. Pass it verbatim as complete_task verification.command, with its output tail:
```bash
T="$MOE_PROJECT_PATH/moe-vscode/node_modules/.bin/tsc"; A="${AFTER:-worktree}"; B="${BEFORE:-HEAD}"; W=$(mktemp -d); fail=0; declare -A C J; M="moe-account-switch moe-compaction-keeper"
for s in B A; do r=$B; [ $s = A ] && r=$A; for b in nobase base; do S="$W/$s-$b"; mkdir -p "$S"; if [ "$r" = worktree ]; then git ls-files -z scripts/mods | tar --null -T - -cf - | tar -x -C "$S"; else git archive "$r" scripts/mods | tar -x -C "$S"; fi; find "$S" -name '*.js' -delete
  for m in $M; do d="$S/scripts/mods/$m"; if [ $b = base ]; then cp -r "$MOE_PROJECT_PATH/scripts/mods/$m/.claude-plugin/types" "$d/.claude-plugin/" || fail=1; fi
    out=$("$T" -p "$d/tsconfig.json" 2>&1); rc=$?; C[$s/$b/$m]=$(grep -o 'error TS[0-9]*' <<<"$out" | sort -u | paste -sd' ' -); J[$s/$b/$m]=$(cd "$S" && find "scripts/mods/$m" -name '*.js' | sort | paste -sd' ' -)
    echo "$s/$b $m tsc_rc=$rc errors=[${C[$s/$b/$m]}] js=[${J[$s/$b/$m]}]"; done; done; done
for m in $M; do
  node -e 'const c=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));process.exit(c.extends==="./.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json"&&c.compilerOptions&&c.compilerOptions.noEmit===true?0:1)' "$W/A-nobase/scripts/mods/$m/tsconfig.json" || { echo "FAIL $m: AFTER tsconfig.json lacks the extends or compilerOptions.noEmit true"; fail=1; }
  [ -n "${J[B/nobase/$m]}" ] || { echo "FAIL $m: BEFORE without base wrote no .js, so this run cannot show the bug"; fail=1; }
  [ -z "${J[A/nobase/$m]}${J[A/base/$m]}" ] || { echo "FAIL $m: AFTER wrote .js"; fail=1; }
  [ "${C[A/base/$m]}" = "${C[B/base/$m]}" ] || { echo "FAIL $m: errors with the base changed"; fail=1; }
  (cd "$W/A-nobase" && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" claude plugin test "scripts/mods/$m" 2>&1 | tail -4; exit "${PIPESTATUS[0]}") || { echo "FAIL $m: claude plugin test"; fail=1; }
done; echo "RESULT before=$B after=$A fail=$fail"; [ "$fail" -eq 0 ]
```
What it does: it writes only under a fresh mktemp -d and runs no npm command (global rail). BEFORE is git archive HEAD. AFTER is the worktree's tracked files under scripts/mods (git ls-files | tar), so your uncommitted edit is included without git stash. It deletes each snapshot's pre-existing .js (5265909c's tracked register.js and register.test.js, which stay on the target until d27edf88's rework lands), so js=[...] lists only what tsc wrote. It runs tsc -p on each mod twice: without the base, then with the control checkout's .claude-plugin/types copied in. tsc is $MOE_PROJECT_PATH/moe-vscode/node_modules/.bin/tsc, TypeScript 7.0.2 native with linux-x64 and win32-x64 packages; packages/moe-daemon's TypeScript has no linux-x64 package on this host and fails with "Unable to resolve" (mem:gotcha-claude-mod-typecheck-on-linux). The checks: AFTER keeps the extends and sets noEmit true; BEFORE without the base writes register.js and register.test.js, which proves the run can see the bug; AFTER writes no .js either way; AFTER's errors with the base equal BEFORE's; claude plugin test passes for both mods under env -i with a temp CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (mem:gotcha-account-switch-plugin-test-stubs).
Error handling: the command never stops at the first failure. tsc's own non-zero exit is expected (diagnostics are the baseline), so it is captured as tsc_rc rather than treated as a failure. Every real failure prints a named FAIL line and makes the final exit non-zero: a missing base copy, a missing or unresolvable tsc (an unset MOE_PROJECT_PATH lands here, because BEFORE then writes no .js), a JSON parse error, an emitted .js, changed errors, or a plugin-test failure.
Expected, as measured by the architect at 58e54180 in a scratch clone: B/nobase tsc_rc=2 and js=[scripts/mods/<mod>/hooks/register.js scripts/mods/<mod>/hooks/register.test.js] for both mods; A/nobase tsc_rc=1 js=[]; B/base and A/base give moe-account-switch errors=[error TS2769 error TS5097] and moe-compaction-keeper errors=[error TS5097], both js=[]; 94 pass and 8 pass; RESULT before=HEAD after=worktree fail=0.
If a wrapper checkpoint commit already holds the edit, the BEFORE check fails ('BEFORE without base wrote no .js'): rerun with `BEFORE=$(git merge-base HEAD moe/work-2026-10-24);` in front of the command. QA re-runs it against the landing as `BEFORE=<completion sha>^ AFTER=<completion sha>;` followed by the command.
In the completion summary, quote the eight B/ and A/ lines, both plugin-test pass counts and the RESULT line: DoD 1 wants the A/nobase listing, DoD 2 wants A/base against B/base. If the moe-account-switch errors with the base are not exactly TS2769 and TS5097 on both sides (for example after an engine refresh of the base types), report that and do not fix it: the scope is the two config files. This RED/GREEN run is also the regression proof for the epic rail 'All fixes must include regression tests or test updates'. DoD 3 limits the diff to the two tsconfig.json files, so do not add a test file.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: tsc -p scripts/mods/<mod>/tsconfig.json writes no file in any checkout. Without the gitignored, engine-written .claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json (every task worktree and git-archive snapshot) it still reports TS5083 but exits 1 with nothing emitted, where it used to write hooks/register.js and hooks/register.test.js and exit 2. With that base present it reports the same errors as before (moe-account-switch TS2769 and TS5097, moe-compaction-keeper TS5097) and emits nothing.
invariants: This task adds, changes or deletes no file under scripts/mods/*/hooks/ or scripts/mods/*/.claude-plugin/
With the base present, each mod's tsc diagnostics are unchanged
compatibility: Claude Code 2.1.318 creates a mod's root tsconfig.json only when it is missing (uVn -> e.make, EEXIST swallowed), so the engine keeps the edited file; the base it writes (dVn) already has noEmit true
hooks.json loads ./register.ts and claude plugin test runs the .ts sources, so mod runtime and tests are unchanged
approvedScope: scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/tsconfig.json and scripts/mods/moe-compaction-keeper/tsconfig.json gain compilerOptions.noEmit true; nothing else changes
reuse: Repeats the engine base's own noEmit option in the tracked child config; no new mechanism
sourceAssumptions: The base sets noEmit true and include ../../hooks, ../../types, ../../tests; when it cannot be read, tsc falls back to **/* in the mod folder and, without noEmit, writes a .js beside each .ts

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Chosen: compilerOptions.noEmit true in each tracked child tsconfig.json. It is inert with the base and protective without it. Rejected: a .gitignore entry for scripts/mods/*/hooks/*.js (tsc would still write the files, the entry would only hide them, and it is outside DoD 3); the launchers copying .claude-plugin/types into worktrees (explicitly out of scope, a possible follow-up row); a committed regression test (DoD 3 limits the diff to the two files, and the step-2 RED/GREEN run is the proof); relying on --noEmit on the command line (every seat would have to remember it, which is how 5265909c happened). The verification command avoids git stash (mem:gotcha-claude-mod-typecheck-on-linux) by taring the worktree's tracked files.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Engine 2.1.318 (binary strings): the root template fSs is exactly {"extends": "./.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json"}, written by uVn through e.make only when neither tsconfig.json nor jsconfig.json exists. The base template dVn has noEmit:true, and the base include ../../hooks, ../../types, ../../tests is relative to the base file. Without the base, TS 7 tsc reports TS5083, TS2307, TS5097 and TS7006, and with no noEmit it writes register.js and register.test.js beside the sources (exit 2: diagnostics, outputs generated); with noEmit it exits 1 (outputs skipped). The tsc that works on WSL is moe-vscode/node_modules/.bin/tsc (7.0.2 native via @typescript/native, linux-x64 present); packages/moe-daemon's 7.0.2 lacks the linux-x64 package. Measured in a scratch clone at 58e54180: RED (unfixed) exits 1 with 'AFTER wrote .js', GREEN exits 0, QA mode (BEFORE=sha^ AFTER=sha) exits 0, and a pre-committed fix with default BEFORE fails with the named BEFORE message.
planningNotes.risks: (1) A checkpoint commit that already holds the edit makes BEFORE=HEAD fixed: the command fails with a named message, and the fix is BEFORE=$(git merge-base HEAD moe/work-2026-10-24). (2) task-d27edf88 (WORKING) deletes hooks/register.js and register.test.js on its own branch; this task must not touch hooks/, so the two rows never share a path. (3) An engine refresh of the base types could move the account-switch baseline off TS2769+TS5097. BEFORE == AFTER is the real invariant: report a moved baseline, don't chase it. (4) Never run tsc -p in the worktree or the shared checkout, and never npm install (global rail); the command runs only in mktemp dirs. (5) isEpicFinal is the rolling fallback of the Stability & Hardening bucket, so there is no epic-wide flow to integrate. The affected surface is the two mods, and the command covers both mods' type check and full plugin test; the landing qualityGate runs parity-check and lint.
